description: This file defines an interface 'IAppLogger<T>' that abstracts logging functionalities to avoid direct dependency on ASP.NET Core logging types. It provides methods for logging informational messages and warnings, with support for message formatting.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: An interface for a generic application logger that abstracts logging operations, allowing dependency injection and facilitating testing without tying to specific logging implementations.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional formatting arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional formatting arguments.
